message:
Woah Mike, cats are always fun but at rare times they do freak out.  I'm fortunate enough to never having any of my cats wail at me like that, but I do remember reading a [thread](http://tinyurl.com/3zqd6) about one such case a while ago.  Usually if you leave them alone and provide them with food and water, the problem goes away in a day or two.  So don't worry about it too much, cats have bad days too.

Oh, how are they with [bathing](http://www.xmission.com/~emailbox/bathing.htm)?
